context: A friend gently presses another to confess feelings
purpose: Teach: 告白/なぜか/何だか/あう/いまだに/貰っ/現に/伴っ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、もういい加減に告白したら？見てて何だかこっちが苦しくなるよ。
lines.en: Hey, just confess already. Watching you, somehow it's me who feels pained.
lines.style: Soft pleading tone with warm, teasing concern from a close friend.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いや、無理だよ。なぜかあの人の前だと言葉が出てこないんだ。
lines.en: No, I can't. For some reason, words just don't come out in front of her.
lines.style: Quiet, embarrassed mumble with a gentle barista's resigned softness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも現に、彼女からチョコ貰ってたじゃない。脈ありに決まってるよ。
lines.en: But in fact, you got chocolates from her, right? She definitely likes you.
lines.style: Excited, knowing voice pushing the point with romantic certainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あれは義理だって。いまだに本気にできないよ、僕なんかが…。
lines.en: Those were obligation chocolates. Even now, I can't take it seriously, someone like me…
lines.style: Self-deprecating, hesitant murmur trailing off into doubt and shyness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そういう自信のなさには必ず後悔が伴って来るんだから。目があう瞬間、勇気出しなよ。
lines.en: That kind of insecurity always brings regret along with it. Next time your eyes meet, find your courage.
lines.style: Firm yet caring push, voice rising with heartfelt encouragement and warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: …もし振られたら、僕、立ち直れる気がしないんだよ。
lines.en: …If I get rejected, I don't think I could recover from it.
lines.style: Vulnerable, almost whispered confession showing genuine fear of rejection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大丈夫、私がついてるから。明日のシフト終わり、ちゃんと伝えて来なよ。
lines.en: It's okay, I'll be right there with you. After tomorrow's shift, go tell her properly.
lines.style: Reassuring, sisterly tone full of confidence and protective affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: …うん。何だか胸がドキドキしてきた。やってみるよ、ありがとう。
lines.en: …Yeah. Somehow my heart's starting to pound. I'll give it a try, thanks.
lines.style: Nervous but resolved, voice steadying with a small grateful smile.
